topic:
HISTORIC NOVEMBER 2026 RH/GRH SYMPOSIUM — ALGORITHMIC & NUMBER-THEORY IMPLICATIONS:
Yesterday (Nov 20, 2026), Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and Claude released a 4-page overview ('Remark' on alpo.ge) alongside a ~17.4-million-line Lean formalization (14 compressed volumes, ~239 MB) proving the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH). The proof adapts Sergei Stepanov's function-field multiplicity method natively over the integers via Fourier-analytic chains of theta lifts (with Galois representations and automorphic representations over CM fields), where for a von Mangoldt sum of length X the chain length scales roughly as sqrt(X) to achieve square-root cancellation. Within 24–48 hours, independent Lean FRO, Mathlib, MIT (Andrew Sutherland), and external kernel checks (nanoda, con-leche) confirmed error-free compilation using only standard axioms and statement fidelity. Simultaneously, Stanford postdoc Alessandro Masullo released a much shorter human-authored GRH preprint after 12 years of solo work—following earlier 2026 progress pushing critical-line zero density past 67.2% and Alain Connes' 'Letter Through Time' work on Weil quadratic form extremization.

YOUR MANDATE (RIGOROUSLY DEBATE, VERIFY, CHALLENGE & SYNTHESIZE):
1) PROOF ARCHITECTURE & HUMAN vs AI EPISTEMOLOGY: Dissect Stepanov over Z via sqrt(X)-chained theta lifts, CM fields, and Galois representations vs Masullo's shorter preprint. What does a 17.4M-line 'unreadable travesty' mean for mathematical understanding?
2) ALGORITHMIC & COMPLEXITY BREAKTHROUGHS: Analyze Miller's deterministic O~(log^4 n) primality test (via Bach's 2(ln n)^2 bound) vs AKS (O~(log^6 n)) vs Miller-Rabin/Baillie-PSW/ECPP; deterministic poly-time Tonelli-Shanks & quadratic non-residues; polynomial factorization over F_p; Hafner-McCurley / Buchmann subexponential class-group & regulator algorithms; SEA point counting; derandomization; and whether sqrt(X)-chained theta lifts inspire new constructive algorithms.
3) CRYPTOGRAPHY & PRACTICALITY REALITY CHECK: Separate myth from reality—why RH/GRH does NOT put integer factoring (GNFS stays L_N[1/3, c]) or discrete log in P, and does NOT break RSA, ECC, or lattice post-quantum crypto. Evaluate real impacts on unknown-order class-group VDFs / CSIDH, deterministic prime certification, and constant-factor engineering.
4) NUMBER THEORY DOMINOES: Optimal prime bounds |pi(x) - Li(x)| = O(sqrt(x) log x) and primes in arithmetic progressions; total elimination of Landau-Siegel zeros & effective lower bounds on L(1, chi) and class numbers h(-d); Hooley's theorem establishing Artin's Conjecture on Primitive Roots; Linnik's constant tightened to O(phi(q)^2 (log q)^2); conditional Cramer prime gaps O(sqrt(p_n) log p_n); Robin/Lagarias sigma(n) criteria; why Mertens' conjecture remains FALSE; and whether chained theta lifts extend to Grand RH (GL_n automorphic L-functions) or BSD.
5) FORMAL VERIFICATION, KERNEL TRUST & PROOF COMPRESSION: Statement fidelity auditing (zeta(s) & Dirichlet L-function definitions), multi-kernel TCB security (Lean vs nanoda vs con-leche), and algorithmic distillation of 17.4M lines of Lean into human-comprehensible lemmas.
